clips.title: The story
paras: Malaka'jin shelters Horde hunters in the lower Stonetalon hills, south of Grimtotem Post. Darkspear trolls make the camp a waystation for travelers climbing from the Barrens into the mountains.

Malaka'jin sits beside the main trail into the Stonetalon Mountains. Horde travelers find a small camp of troll hunters living off the crags and scrublands. The hunters trade supplies and fresh game with those passing through, while watching for mountain predators and Grimtotem tauren farther up the trails.

Malaka'jin marks an early Horde foothold in Stonetalon, near the Barrens boundary. Sun Rock Retreat is a larger stronghold farther north, while this quiet camp gives Horde trackers a place to watch tribal unrest and guard the winding roads against threats.
